title.narrative: GEF GOLD+ in Nigeria: Enhancing the formalization and mercury-free gold in Nigeria

description.narrative: Child project part of the GOLD+ programme on artisanal gold mining under the leadership of Conservation International and with funding from the GEF. This project was a component of a broader national project on mercury in Nigeria. The GEF Sec requested to separate the component on artisanal and small-scale gold mining (ASGM) from the national programme and to include it in the GOLD+ programme that is dedicated to ASGM.
